description: Return the integer part of the <dataType> value, removing any fraction, as ECMAScript Math.trunc does (toward zero: trunc(-1.5) is -1.0). The result is a double: write to_integer(trunc(v)) for an integer. A result that would be NaN, or a NaN argument, is an error. An integer is not accepted: write to_double(v).

errorsThrown.reason: the result would be NaN, or an operand is NaN
